title: The Milk Spilled
lines: Ben filled a big pot with milk.
He tipped it and the milk spilled.
It dripped on the red rug.
Dad picked up a rag and grinned.
Dad dumped the wet rag in the tub.
Ben was sad, but Dad hugged him.
Then Ben helped and did not spill.

questions.ask: What did the milk drip on?
questions.listenFor: The red rug. This is stated in the story - point them back to that line rather than giving the answer.
He picked up the pot, gave Ben a rag, and dumped the wet rag in the tub. Any two of those three is plenty.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben will spill the milk again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You want a reason from the story - "no, he used both hands" or "yes, the pot is big for him."
